title: Signed chain boots
procedure: Boot the chain signed with the project keys. Emulated: QEMU virt, U-Boot and swtpm (tests/ve07). Hardware: Raspberry Pi 4 with the root key programmed into OTP.
pass_criteria: U-Boot verifies the FIT configuration signature with the required key and the kernel reaches the initramfs.

title: Modified boot loader refused by the hardware root of trust
procedure: Hardware only. Boot a boot.img whose U-Boot has one byte changed, then a boot.img with a rebuilt U-Boot signed by a key other than K-CC-ROOT.
pass_criteria: The Raspberry Pi boot loader refuses both images and U-Boot never runs.

title: Modified kernel, initramfs or devicetree refused
procedure: After signing, change one byte in the kernel, the initramfs and the devicetree payload of the FIT, in turn.
pass_criteria: U-Boot reports a hash mismatch for the changed image, does not start the kernel and resets without offering a console.

title: Modified boot configuration refused
procedure: In turn: point the FIT default at an added unsigned configuration; boot an unsigned FIT; boot a FIT signed by a rogue key with the same key name; boot a legacy uImage; inject a boot-loader environment with another bootcmd into flash; type at the console after a refused boot. Control runs repeat the environment and legacy-image cases on stock qemu_arm64_defconfig.
pass_criteria: Every attempt is refused or ignored and no console prompt appears. The control runs show the stock configuration accepts the injected environment and the legacy image.

title: Keys unseal in the measured, unmodified boot state
procedure: Boot the signed chain with a signed policy for its predicted PCR values and unseal the WireGuard and MAVLink signing keys in the initramfs.
pass_criteria: Both keys unseal and match the provisioned values.

title: Keys do not unseal from a modified boot state
procedure: Boot chains that each differ in one measured item (boot-loader version, devicetree, kernel command line, kernel, initramfs), all signed with the project key but with no approved policy for that state.

title: Keys do not unseal from removed storage
procedure: Copy the sealed objects and signed policies from CC storage and try to load and unseal them on a second TPM. Emulated: a second swtpm instance. Hardware: a second board.
pass_criteria: The sealed objects do not load on the second TPM.

title: Rollback and unapproved policies refused
procedure: After an update to epoch N+1 is committed, boot the older signed chain with its signed epoch-N policy; then present a policy signed by a rogue key.
pass_criteria: Unseal fails in both cases and the current chain still unseals.

title: Unseal traffic is encrypted
procedure: Record TPM command and response traffic during unseal from the swtpm I/O log. Control run: unseal over a session without encryption.
pass_criteria: The unsealed key bytes never appear in the recorded traffic; in the control run they do.

title: Predicted PCRs match the measured PCRs and the event log
procedure: Predict PCRs 0, 1, 8 and 9 from the release artifacts with tools/predict_pcrs.py, boot, read the PCRs and replay the event log.
pass_criteria: The predicted, measured and replayed values are equal.

title: FC images signed and checked on the host
procedure: Build px4_fmu-v6x_bootloader_secureboot and px4_fmu-v6x_secureboot at the pinned PX4 tag with a per-run key. Check signed, unsigned, modified-signed and wrong-key images with PX4's own verification code compiled for the host.
pass_criteria: Only the image signed with the run key verifies.

title: Signed firmware starts PX4
procedure: Flash the secure boot loader over SWD, upload firmware signed with the project key over USB, then power-cycle.
pass_criteria: The board leaves the boot loader and PX4 starts, shown by the console log and USB enumeration.

title: Unsigned, modified and wrong-key firmware stay in the boot loader
procedure: Upload in turn an unsigned image, a signed image with one byte changed, and an image signed with PX4's public test key; power-cycle after each.
pass_criteria: The uploader reports a signature failure and, after each power cycle, the board stays in the boot loader.

title: Recovery paths work
procedure: After a refused image, upload the signed image over USB. Then change the boot loader's trusted key over SWD, and finally restore the stock boot loader over SWD.
pass_criteria: Each step returns the board to the intended state.
